title: Beta constellation boundary expansion

scope.boundarySource: IAU Delporte text files from iauarchive.eso.org, retrieved 2026-09-13
scope.artChange: Expanded the current constellation roster from 8 to 12 and added IAU J2000 boundary rings plus illustrative anchor routes for Lyra, Aquila, Taurus, and Sagittarius.

limitations: The new anchor routes are explanatory sky-chart lines and do not claim physical relationships.
Browser screenshots for the new four constellation passports remain pending.
Beta still requires 24 hero stars and 24 rights-cleared nebula images.
